draft.heroMessage: Guiding Fort Worth families to new beginnings—your real estate journey starts here.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m Sascha Chatman, your dedicated REALTOR® serving the Greater Fort Worth area. Whether you're buying your first home or selling your third, I’m here to provide steady guidance and market expertise every step of the way.
draft.tagline: Clear Guidance. Strong Partnership. Fort Worth Focused.
draft.aboutParagraph: Since 2017, Chatman Realty Group has proudly served as a trusted advisor for families across Fort Worth and the DFW area. My mission is simple: put your needs first, deliver professional service, and ensure you are informed from start to finish. With a wealth of knowledge and a caring team beside me, I strive to make your real estate transactions straightforward and successful—so you can focus on what matters most, your future. Let’s achieve your real estate goals together.
draft.conciergeLine: Curious about the Fort Worth market or need help finding your next home? Reach out—I'm always ready to offer honest advice and hands-on support.
draft.contactLine: Contact me anytime at (817) 383-2423 or 817-668-0311 to discuss your home buying or selling needs.
draft.tone: Warm, professional, community-focused, with an approachable and trustworthy voice.

websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Search all area real estate for sale on one easy-to-use site. Including homes, condos, townhomes, land, and foreclosure properties for sale.

sections.title: Things to Think About When Selling Your Home
sections.body: Once we've determined the price, I can give you advice about the little things that you can do to stage your home to get you the highest possible price! You'd be surprised by the simple measures you can take to dress up your home to attract more qualified buyers. I have a marketing plan that is designed to get maximum exposure to the buyers that are currently looking, and all agents that have buyers.

sections.title: Owning a Home is More Affordable Than You Think
sections.body: Contrary to belief owning a home is much more affordable than it has been a a very long time. Interest rates are much lower than they have been in the past, which is a huge benefit to you.
